items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: In the past, Plato Smith has been the master ceremonies. I was just trying to familiarize him with the program.

ctx.x: Yeah, you did. I mean, it seemed to me yesterday at the concert that you had everything planned and you knew when we were talking about.

I did. I did. Because this is a different incident altogether. What we're talking about. We're talking about playing dances in the olden days. Well, you had a set format because you went to a different city every night. And possibly sometime you'd stop in a city maybe for two weeks and that was considered a big contract. And two weeks, man, we really had a rest. But yesterday, you're referring to yesterday at the concert, the reason why I had a list made is because of the new master ceremonies that was there.…

Well, I'm trying to notice everything, you know. Well, that's great. You're inquisitive. You told me about how nothing was rehearsed yesterday. That amazed me because the band, you know, everything was so pretty. All the hominis seemed right to me, you know.
